title: A local personal agent you can actually inspect
sub: Live demo of every feature - real CLI runs, start to finish

title: How this demo was made
sub: Real terminal runs of the real CLI. The model is a scripted local mock (no real tokens spent) - every CLI feature shown is real. Anything not live-tested is labeled.

title: Install: clone, npm ci, build
sub: From zero to a built checkout

title: Test suite
sub: 42 automated tests guard the loop, tools, memory and safety rails

title: Setup and config check
sub: npm run setup writes a local .env. Here it points at a scripted local mock model on 127.0.0.1:8090 - no real model, no real tokens.

title: Guided connect: email, Telegram, Slack
sub: NEW: say what you want to connect; secrets are typed hidden, stored in .env with mode 600, never logged. Live provider sends untested.

title: First task: create a file
sub: Every tool call is reviewed before it runs. Nothing executes without your yes.

sub: Fetch and summarize a public page - approved explicitly, content treated as untrusted data

title: Memory
sub: Explicit notes: save a preference, then answer from it later

title: Email from plain English
sub: 'Send mail to X saying Y' - the draft is shown exactly, and sends only after you type yes. Demo SMTP is a placeholder, so the send honestly fails.

title: Git tools
sub: Init a repo and commit the greeting file - Conventional Commits, reviewed calls

title: Command runner
sub: Opt-in shell-free commands. Each call shows the exact command and needs your yes

title: Plugins

title: Browser tools
sub: Persistent Chromium with an allowlist - navigate, read pages, fill forms
